35 PERSONALISING YOUR CAR

Accessories.
Our designers and engineers are involved
in setting the specifications for each of the
accessories for the new Flying Spur, so that
they work perfectly with your car.
The Styling Specification offers a range of
additions in carbon fibre, the material of choice
for the motorsport industry, to add to your
car’s dynamic exterior. Elements include a
front splitter, air blades, side sills, rear diffuser
and boot lip.
Other accessories include protective,
personalised car covers for both indoor and
outdoor use, protective floor covers, and
winter tyres. A child seat in the same hide
colour as your car’s interior can even be
embroidered with your child’s name.
For details of our full accessories range,
please contact your local Bentley retailer.
